title: Loi sur l'immigration au Quebec (Quebec Immigration Act)
verified_how: NOT verified against the register: www.legisquebec.gouv.qc.ca refused every request with HTTP 403 from Amazon CloudFront ('Request blocked'), so neither the register's own title page nor its 'a jour au' date could be read. The French title and RLRQ chapter number recorded here are corroborated only by LegisQuebec page titles and PDF headings that appeared in web-search results (e.g. 'chapitre I-0.2.1 LOI SUR L'IMMIGRATION AU QUEBEC'), which is not a substitute for the register.
notes: Listed rather than recorded as a federal gap because of the Canada-Quebec Accord relating to Immigration and Temporary Admission of Aliens (1991): Quebec selects its own economic immigrants and issues the Certificat d'acceptation du Quebec, which a temporary foreign worker generally must hold before Canada will issue a work permit. The work permit itself is still federal, under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act, S.C. 2001, c. 27, and SOR/2002-227.
